0022600222.text: The Lakers (10-2, first in the West and the Pacific, on a six-game win streak) are on the road against the Milwaukee Bucks (1-9, 15th in the East, on a six-game losing streak) in their 13th game of the season. Quentin Grimes is day-to-day with a finger injury and is a game-time decision for the Lakers, while Tyler Herro is out for Milwaukee with a knee bruise. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and they split their 2025-26 series 1-1, with the most recent meeting a 105-101 Lakers loss in Los Angeles on January 9, 2026.
